title: Pure Mist Blackjack 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Blackjack delivers the distinctive taste of classic Liquorice and Aniseed, capturing the spicy, sugary essence of a much-loved confectionery flavour. This bold and nostalgic e-liquid offers a smooth and satisfying vape, perfect for those who enjoy sweet, spicy blends with an irresistible retro vibe. Available in a variety of VG/PG ratios, the 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Blackjack provides a flavour-packed option for adult vapers. Made in the UK with premium ingredients, this e-liquid delivers consistent quality and satisfaction.
